verdict.rationale: Codex is built around OpenAI's own GPT-5.x/codex models; the evidence only shows different OpenAI model variants (e.g., gpt-5.3-codex, gpt-5.3-codex-spark) and comparisons against competitor tools like Claude/Gemini in separate products, not a feature letting users select among multiple third-party providers within a single Codex session.
